The user wants me to analyze the provided GitHub project data and produce a structured Markdown report in Chinese. The report must follow a specific structure with five sections. I need to be rigorous, only use the provided data, cite specific projects and numbers, and keep the total length between 1000-1600 Chinese characters.

Let me first analyze the data:

Projects list (28 projects):
1. yetone/cumora - 2416 stars, 265 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - "Where agent teams gather. Cross-platform team chat where AI agents are first-class teammates"
2. ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI - 1984 stars, 88 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - DSH TUI plugin, Claude Code style
3. Leutenegger/book-to-skill - 1193 stars, 142 forks, Python, AI Agent - Turn PDF books into Claude Code skills
4. jdshfhds/northcinder - 1158 stars, 4 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Buyer-run shopping agent MCP software
5. Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space... - 1002 stars, 61 forks, Unknown, AI Agent - Benchmark report
6. zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC - 864 stars, 27 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - DSH Windows/Linux desktop client
7. ysr666/dsh-vision-router - 766 stars, 32 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Vision tools for text-only DSH agents
8. s1dashu/ip-as-logo-skill - 727 stars, 25 forks, Unknown, AI Agent - Agent Skill for logo design
9. NousResearch/Hermes-Bot-Mode - 616 stars, 98 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Bot mode for Hermes desktop
10. decionis/agent-safe-pipeline - 533 stars, 58 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - AI agent safety/governance pipeline
11. Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook - 499 stars, 24 forks, HTML, AI Agent - DSH handbook (Chinese/English)
12. SheberDavid/v4-flash-godmode... - 499 stars, 12 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - DSH agent preset for opencode-go
13. vibeinging/deepseek-harness-desktop-app - 487 stars, 7 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - DSH desktop app workspace
14. myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop - 468 stars, 21 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - DSH Windows desktop client
15. yjh051108/dsh-router-standard - 332 stars, 32 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Task-aware reasoning-mode router for DSH
16. fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio - 296 stars, 33 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - DSH zero-code desktop with plugin discovery
17. ryzqi/learn-agent - 240 stars, 35 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - 20-chapter Chinese AI Agent tutorial with TS code
18. wzchav/tokentab - 224 stars, 14 forks, Python, AI Agent - CLI for token usage/cost tracking
19. bawadou/ai-data-extractor - 213 stars, 88 forks, Python, AI Agent - Extractor for AI coding assistant chat histories
20. ryanlab/bivor - 204 stars, 23 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - macOS desktop workbench for pi coding agent
21. Endokelp/Endoplexity - 201 stars, 0 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - Agentic browser control via Claude/Cursor
22. soumatheusgomes/vibe-coding-toolkit - 194 stars, 45 forks, Unknown, AI Agent - Curated AI-coding toolkit
23. Kronop/vibe-aso - 188 stars, 21 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Claude Code skill for ASO
24. fellowgeek/mcp-memory - 188 stars, 11 forks, Python, AI Agent - MCP server for persistent long-term memory
25. zjp1997720/zhijian-ai-bluebook... - 182 stars, 17 forks, Unknown, AI Agent - Chinese bluebook for WorkBuddy
26. op7418/pilot-harness - 180 stars, 10 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - CodePilot-inspired desktop client for DSH
27. seyedehsanhadi/sloptrim - 160 stars, 12 forks, Python, AI Agent - Local detector for AI-writing patterns
28. QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu - 158 stars, 19 forks, JavaScript, AI Agent - Desktop companion for DSH
29. hewzhew/dsh-agent-rp - 157 stars, 5 forks, TypeScript, AI Agent - SillyTavern migration for DSH

Key observations:
- DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem is dominant: 10+ projects directly related to DSH (dsh-TUI, Deepseek-Harness-EAC, dsh-vision-router, dsh-handbook, v4-flash-godmode, deepseek-harness-desktop-app, dsh_desktop, dsh-router-standard, deepseek-harness-studio, pilot-harness, dsh-dafeiyu, dsh-agent-rp)
- Desktop clients for AI agents are trending (multiple DSH desktop apps, bivor, cumora, Hermes-Bot-Mode, Endoplexity)
- Agent safety/governance emerging (agent-safe-pipeline)
- Tooling for developer productivity: token tracking (tokentab), chat history extraction (ai-data-extractor), learning resources (learn-agent, dsh-handbook, vibe-coding-toolkit)
- Vision/multimodal capabilities for text-only models (dsh-vision-router, dsh-vision-toolkit)
- Chinese developers very active in DSH ecosystem
- TypeScript/JavaScript dominant, Python for tooling

Now I need to structure the response:

1. 一句话判断 - One sentence judgment
2. 三个高价值信号 - Three high-value signals with evidence
3. 值得优先研究的项目 - Up to 5 projects with target audience, problem solved, next steps
4. 风险与误区 - Risks and misconceptions
5. 行动建议 - 3 concrete actions for next 7 days

Length target: 1000-1600 Chinese characters.

Let me draft each section.

Section 1: 一句话判断
"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 生态正在形成以桌面客户端、视觉增强、Agent 技能化为核心的完整工具链，中国开发者主导了从 CLI 到 GUI 的二次开发浪潮。"

Section 2: 三个高价值信号
Signal 1: DSH 生态爆发式增长，桌面端成为主战场
Evidence: 10+ DSH 相关项目，其中桌面客户端类项目 6 个（zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC 864⭐、vibeinging/deepseek-harness-desktop-app 487⭐、myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop 468⭐、fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio 296⭐、op7418/pilot-harness 180⭐、QCYTSN/dsh-dafeiyu 158⭐），TUI 增强 ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI 1984⭐
Why important: 说明开发者需求从终端转向可视化工作台，DSH 正成为类 Claude Code 的开放替代方案

Signal 2: Agent 安全治理与可观测性工具链雏形显现
Evidence: decionis/agent-safe-pipeline 533⭐ 58🍴 提供不可变意图捕获+人工审批执行管线；wzchav/tokentab 224⭐ 解决多模型成本核算；bawadou/ai-data-extractor 213⭐ 88🍴 支持 6+ 编码助手聊天记录导出
Why important: 企业级落地的前置条件——审计、成本控制、数据归属正在被开源社区率先解决

Signal 3: 技能化与多模态能力下沉，降低 Agent 定制门槛
Evidence: Leutenegger/book-to-skill 1193⭐ 将 PDF 转为 Claude Code Skill；ysr666/dsh-vision-router 766⭐ 为纯文本模型接入免费视觉链；s1dashu/ip-as-logo-skill 727⭐ 专用 Logo 生成 Skill；Kronop/vibe-aso 188⭐ 覆盖 ASO 全流程
Why important: 技能封装让领域知识可复用、可分发，多模态路由器让中小模型获得视觉能力，推动 Agent 从"会聊天"向"会干活"跨越

Section 3: 值得优先研究的项目 (5 projects)
1. yetone/cumora (2416⭐) - 适合技术负责人/架构师 - 解决多 Agent 协作与人机共同工作的基础设施问题 - 建议：克隆本地跑通云端/自带模型双模式，评估团队聊天集成可行性
2. decionis/agent-safe-pipeline (533⭐) - 适合安全合规负责人/后端负责人 - 解决 Agent 动作提议与授权分离、人工介入审计 - 建议：阅读 SafeExecutor 与 Decionis 策略引擎代码，原型接入现有 CI/CD 审批流
3. Leutenegger/book-to-skill (1193⭐) - 适合产品经理/知识工程师 - 解决技术文档转可执行 Skill 的自动化 - 建议：投喂 1-2 本内部技术手册 PDF，验证生成 Skill 在 Claude Code/DSH 中的实战效果
4. ryzqi/learn-agent (240⭐) - 适合新入职开发者/培训负责人 - 解决 Agent 架构系统性学习缺口，含 20 章可运行 TS 代码 - 建议：纳入团队入职必修课，按章节分配实战练习
5. fellowgeek/mcp-memory (188⭐) - 适合基础设施工程师 - 解决 Agent 长期记忆持久化与全文检索 - 建议：部署 MCP 服务端，对接现有 Agent 框架，压测 SQLite FTS5 在万条记忆下的延迟

Section 4: 风险与误区
- Stars ≠ 生产采用：cumora 2416⭐ 但首次出现仅 2026-08-19，可能处于早期关注期，需关注 Issue 活跃度与 Release 频率
- DSH 生态项目高度重叠：6 个桌面客户端功能同质化严重（均基于 Electron+Node.js 打包），可能分散贡献者精力
- 缺失关键指标：无 Commit 频率、Contributor 数、Issue 解决率、真实下载量，无法判断项目健康度
- 中文文档占比高：dsh-handbook、learn-agent、zhijian-ai-bluebook 等核心资料以中文为主，国际化推广存在语言壁垒

Section 5: 行动建议
1. 今日内：拉取 cumora 与 agent-safe-pipeline 代码
